topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct and security acknowledgments; sanctions procedure (POL-01 4.7)
Board risk committee oversees cyber risk quarterly
Group CISO and the Distribution security and compliance lead; service director accountable for the service (POL-01)
Role descriptions and training for platform and customer service staff
Objectives and performance reviews include security duties for platform staff

topic_label: Quality information to support internal control
control_description: Telemetry, order, and alert data feed internal dashboards. Gap: no complete inventory of in-scope components (gateways, cloud services, vendor portal)
gap: Component inventory for the system description incomplete
remediation: Inventory of the 2,600 gateways, cloud services, and the vendor portal

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Group policies and the Distribution supplement communicated to staff
Customer agreements state availability and delivery commitments. Gap: no system description, no written security commitments, and no complementary user entity controls defined for customers
gap: No system description or written security commitments
remediation: Write the system description and service commitments; define complementary user entity controls (customer portal user management; site access to gateways)

control_description: Service objectives: tank data accuracy, replenishment before reorder points, availability
Distribution register (P01 DS-006, DS-007) covers the service
Fraudulent order risk analyzed (P01 DS-008)
Change risk reviewed for platform releases. Gap: gateway firmware changes pushed through the vendor portal are not risk-reviewed
Group internal audit assesses common controls yearly (P07); service-level evaluation not yet planned
gap: No separate evaluation of the service
remediation: Add the service to the 2027 internal audit plan

control_description: POA&M and quarterly reporting to the board risk committee

topic_label: Selection and development of control activities
control_description: Common control catalog applies (P02)
Group guardrails and change management in provider A
Group policies and the Distribution supplement. Gap: no service-specific operating procedures for gateway onboarding and customer offboarding
remediation: Gateway onboarding and customer offboarding procedures

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO and MFA for workforce; encryption with group-managed keys
Workforce access through identity governance. Gap: vendor portal users created by the vendor on request, outside identity governance
remediation: Federate the vendor portal to SYS-G1 or quarterly review of its 11 users (POAM-019)

control_description: Platform roles separated for operations, support, and engineering
Provider data centers (carved out); customer-site gateways in locked enclosures owned by customers
Media sanitization standard; returned gateways wiped

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Hub firewalls; private access point for gateways; no inbound path to customer sites
Telemetry encrypted in transit; customer data exports limited to portal users

topic_label: Prevention or detection of unauthorized software
control_description: EDR on cloud workloads. Gap: gateway firmware is not integrity-checked before the vendor pushes it
remediation: Signed firmware with hash check in the two-approver process

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability scanning of cloud workloads; gateway configuration drift not monitored
remediation: Daily configuration report from the vendor portal

control_description: SIEM monitors the platform; telemetry anomaly rules flag sudden level changes
SOC triage under POL-03
Group IR plan. Gap: customer incident notice terms (72 hours for the 12 largest) are in the matrix but not exercised
Warm standby region; failover tested 2026-04
Platform releases through the pipeline with approval. Gap: vendor firmware pushes bypass change management
BIA (P05 BP-DS04) and manual replenishment procedure

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Group vendor program. Gap: the telemetry gateway vendor portal lacks MFA and has not been reviewed since 2023 (P07 SA-9; scenario gap 6)
gap: Critical vendor without MFA or oversight

control_description: Capacity monitoring and autoscaling

topic_label: Environmental protections, backup, and recovery infrastructure
control_description: Database replicas, warm standby region, daily backups to the provider B vault
Failover tested 2026-04 within the 8-hour RTO; manual replenishment procedure not tested with customer service
remediation: Test the manual call-down with customer service

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Out of scope for the first report: customers asked for Security, Availability, and Processing Integrity. Confidentiality of customer usage data is reconsidered for the 2028 period

remediation: Daily reconciliation for the 640 utility sites (DS-007)
